messages:
sarah: Heads-up — small change window tonight 22:00-23:00 UTC. We need a quick cross-service handshake: API, runtime, console, router. Minimal traffic; rolling canary.

sarah: Plan: deploy runtime v3.9.1, console migration toggle, router header split, API minor schema change. Rollback plan documented below.

mike: @sarah is runtime pinned anywhere? I want to avoid a calico mismatch with the router shim.

jordan: Console needs a feature-flag flip for the new schema. Migration is non-blocking but requires the flag to be ON before API cutover.

lee: Router change is header-split only — 10% canary for 15m, then 50% for 10m, then 100%. We’ll keep runtime v3.8 as fallback variant for 30m after deploy.

deploy-bot: preflight checks passed: CI ✅, infra quotas ✅, canary pool healthy ✅. Linked PRs: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4821, /pull/4822.

mike: For pinning: set runtime variant `v3.9.1-unstable` as the canary and `v3.8-stable` as fallback. If latency > 120ms or error rate > 0.8% in first 15m, we roll back to `v3.8-stable`.

sarah: Noted. Jordan — can you confirm console flag name? I’ll include it in the rollout notes.

jordan: Flag is `console.new_schema_v2`. I'll push a quick PR to toggle default OFF -> ON for the canary users list. PR: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/901.

lee: Router runbook: `router canary --header-split X-New-Schema --percent 10 --duration 15m` then bump per above. If 503 spike, `router rollback --tag canary`.

mike: Adding rollback checklist here: 1) revert router split -> 0% 2) squash console flag -> OFF 3) pin API to old schema commit (sha: a1b2c3d) 4) pin runtime back to `v3.8-stable` 5) invalidate KV cache prefix `schema:v2`

sarah: Release notes snippet I'll post to #release-notes after deploy: "runtime: v3.9.1 (perf kernels), api: minor schema opt-in, console: schema v2 flag, router: header split rollout". Anyone object?

lee: No objections. I’ll own router ops during the window.

jordan: I can watch console logs, will alert if migration errors > 5/min.

mike: I’ll monitor runtime latencies and tail errors. If we see KV churn, call rollback.

deploy-bot: deploybot: starting orchestration at 22:00 UTC. Canary region: us-east-1. Canary targets: runtime=v3.9.1-unstable, router=10% header-split, console flag on for canary list.

oncall-bot: reminder: quiet window enabled for 21:50-23:10 UTC. Pager duty rotations: lee (primary), mike (secondary).

sarah: Thanks all — please react with :thumbsup: when you’ve noted ownership. I’ll kick at 22:00.

lee: :thumbsup:

mike: :thumbsup:

jordan: :thumbsup:

sarah: Kicking in 10m. If anything unexpected, use this thread and call the oncall pager.

deploy-bot: canary deployed. Monitoring 15m window. Link to metrics dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/board/serve/chan-4821.

mike: Observing a small latency bump +0.03s first 3 mins — within tolerances.

jordan: Console logs show 0 migration errors so far.

lee: Router 10% holding. No 5xx spike.

sarah: After 15m, plan to move to 50% if metrics stable.

deploy-bot: canary increment to 50% applied.

mike: Latency steady, errors flat. Proceeding with 50% hold.

jordan: Still clean on console.

lee: If all good after 10m, I’ll finish the ramp to 100% and then we can flip fallback window off.

deploy-bot: canary complete — 100% routing applied. Post-deploy checks running.

mike: Post-deploy tail errors slightly elevated (0.12% -> 0.2%) but within rollback threshold? threshold is 0.8% so OK. Keeping eyes.

jordan: Migration finished for 99.2% users. Minor retries only.

sarah: Great work. I’ll update release notes and close the window. If anything regresses overnight, follow rollback checklist.

deploy-bot: orchestration finished successfully. All services healthy.

oncall-bot: quiet window end at 23:10 UTC.

sarah: Closing thread — archiving notes to /releases/2026-03-21-quick-window.md and tagging PRs. Thanks everyone.
